hypothesis: The energy-accounting capability leaves a recurring structural difference in the connected signal transformations of correct and wrong natural answers. Individual failures should carry parts of that difference before they emit the wrong climb calculation.
what_went_wrong_before: A hardware split was allowed to drive sample expansion and population testing. Those choices did not answer where an existing failure carries a recurring computation difference. The previous analysis also could not distinguish pre-error structure from the consequence of an emitted error.
why_this_direction: All existing originals now have the same GPU0 arithmetic and full natural projection streams. Overlay these successes and failures independently on one response-coordinate grid, inspect every member and every recorded residual merge, and attribute the differences through the actual weighted projection inputs. No new question, edit, pairwise repair target or statistical gate is needed.
why_it_might_be_wrong: The outcomes are observational. Parameters, wording and prior generated text can create a recurring difference without causing the error. Text alignment leaves gaps and can compare different physical roles. Pre-error support is evidence of timing, not proof of causal responsibility; manual error markers have prose ambiguities. Leave-one-out support does not purify a vector into a capability.
repeating_pattern_check: The investigation has repeatedly substituted a convenient proxy for the path. This run retains group directions, gain, per-member evidence and connected component accounting, with unmatched positions explicit. It does not grow or rebalance the sample, infer patterns from isolated weights, or use answer counts as a trace.

rule.population: Every one of the existing GPU0 originals, classified by the complete saved numerical procedure: 20 climb failures and 25 numerical successes. Retain prose caveats. GPU1 and all proposed new questions are excluded.
rule.alignment: Use the first manifest response, block-base, as the fixed common coordinate grid, independent of new trace values. Reuse annotate/correspond unchanged: ordered unique passage roles, mandatory token or numeral matches, no interpolation. Match each member to this grid; do not form failure-success mate targets. Report coverage and unmatched positions for every member.
rule.overlays: At each aligned grid position and actual merge, save each group mean turn, mean log gain, dispersion and member-versus-rest agreement separately. Turn = unit(merged)-unit(incoming); gain = log(norm(merged)/norm(incoming)). Difference = success overlay minus failure overlay at that same grid position and merge.
rule.recurrence: For each member, omit it before computing the two-group direction and midpoint. Signed distance along that direction is positive on its own group side. Report every signed distance, agreement count and direction stability, plus the strict descriptive subset where all included members have positive margins and positive within-group agreement. Zero has its geometric sign meaning; no chosen score cutoff or population-significance gate. The strict subset does not replace the continuous per-member map or establish component purity.
rule.timing: For each failure retain prediction indices before the first wrong statement, from that statement through the prediction emitting the first wrong mathematical operator, and after that operator has entered the input. An earlier ambiguous premise gets a separate conservative sensitivity marker. Report first observed positive positions as descriptive observations, never causal onset. Calculate a separate pre-error overlay in which every contributing failure is at or before its own wrong-token prediction. Merely marking the held-out member is insufficient when its peers have already made the error. The unrestricted full-path overlay stays beside it; both receive component accounting.
rule.components: Enumerate every attention-output and feed-forward-down projection in the retained original native graph across all layers. Read original weights only. Decompose each recorded turn into the normalized weighted-input contributions plus incoming-residual/normalization contribution; verify reconstruction against the actual recorded turn. Independently average parts within successes and failures. Account for their difference along the group direction; retain signed head and FF-unit contributions, per-member agreement, and passage sharing. These are contributions to the observed turn, not claims that units store physics.
rule.parameters: List per-response evidence with m, v, drop, loss, rise and family. Compare scores and component profiles directly across these existing variations, including same-parameter cases where available. No new sample or per-cell fitting. Report unresolved confounds.
rule.result: Report maps across every merge and passage, per-failure support and timing, components and coverage, with interpretations and counterevidence. No weight construction until independent acceptance.

prediction.expected_observation: The earlier original-only overlap located the largest climb difference in layer-13 feed-forward and distributed contributions in neighboring layers. Expect that location to remain recognizable on GPU0 and some, not necessarily all, failures to carry a similarly directed difference before the wrong operator. Record the number and identities; no numeric repair prediction applies because no model is edited.
prediction.failures_only: All 20 observed target failures remain in the denominator; report pre-error support separately from after-error support. Original generation produced 25 numerical successes and zero caps. Repairs and regressions are not measured by this observational run.

would_weaken_it: Differences occur only after the wrong token; held-out failures disagree in the relevant passages; locations/components change arbitrarily between failures; or the same structural evidence follows parameters/wording irrespective of outcome. Any of these narrows the hypothesis support and is reported, not repaired by acquiring more data.

population.derivation: Count all complete original GPU0 labels; use every member.

merges.derivation: Enumerate connected residual ADD operations in native layer order.
